title: Antique Store
content: Hi guys, I have been having reoccurring dreams for a little over a year now. A common location is an antique store, which is set up in a multi-story house- not very large, but packed with goodies. Recently, the other story became inaccessible, as they renovated it into actual living space, but I can still shop on the main level. This remains consistent in all of my dreams. Does anybody else visit an antique store frequently in their dreams?
